ceiling_directive: Construct a fixed, D,K-independent sound and complete within- and cross-regime orientation rule system, and prove that its closure equals the canonical SI-PAG throughout Dai et al.'s published class.
improvement_directive: Resolve the deferred extension calculus by stating the finite rule list and proving a common-basal extension theorem that supplies tail and arrowhead completions for every circle left by its closure. Then combine that theorem with the existing endpoint-update argument to obtain unconditional polynomial-time mark closure.
critique: The note proves exact endpoint invariance only through an exponential global enumeration over normalized target-residual certificates; it does not deliver the finite sound and complete local orientation calculus posed by the project. The polynomial closure lemma is conditional on an unspecified fixed rule system, while construction and semantic completeness of that system remain entirely open in oeq:si-extension-calculus. The finite normalization and paired global witnesses are a narrow extension of Dai et al.'s published MAG formulas and equivalence characterization, not a practical or polynomial discovery result, so the delivered contribution is subfield rather than field. The TL;DR, introduction, and scope sections do not stalely claim that the missing local calculus or conditional-independence discovery problem has been solved.
